title: ActorSkill
description: actor.skill@1: a skill, the document an agent loads to do one kind of job well (ADR-058). It follows the open Markdown-skill shape (a name, a one-line description, Markdown instructions) with what OpenVibe adds: a slug, a version, up to ten TEXT resources, and REQUIRES, what the skill may ask an agent to do. A skill GRANTS NOTHING: requires only declares; the agent's level and approvals decide every step (actor approvals, HO1), and a step of a kind the skill did not declare is a scan finding (actor.skill-listing@1). A v1 skill RUNS AS A PROMPT and nothing else: no code, no binary, no install recipe (a skill that runs code waits for a sandbox and a new major). DESCRIPTION is the only part an agent reads before it loads the skill (progressive disclosure), so it says when to use it. The INTEGRITY block is a sha256 over the canonical JSON of the document: it shows the file was not edited after it was written and says nothing about who wrote it, so the AUTHOR is a claim; the registry's listing is the only place a publisher is vouched for. The canonical JSON is the document's own fields, in this order: skill, slug, name, description, version, instructions, resources, requires, runs, license, author; an optional field that is absent or empty is left out; resources are [{ path, media_type, text }] in the document's order; requires is { kinds, apps, hosts } with empty lists left out; author is { subject } or { subject, name }; the value is the compact JSON of that object (no spaces). CREATED_AT is not hashed.

slug.description: Its name in the registry: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

name.description: What a person reads on its card.

description.description: When to use it, in one line: the only part an agent reads before it loads the skill.

instructions.description: What to do, in Markdown. The agent reads it as guidance; it never grants a permission.

resources.description: Text the instructions refer to (a checklist, a template, a table). Never code to run.

path.description: A relative name, no "..", ending in .md, .txt, .json or .csv.

requires.description: What the skill may ask an agent to do. It grants nothing: each step still goes through the agent's level and approvals.

kinds.description: The kinds of act (actor approvals, HO1) its steps may be.

apps.description: Connected apps it uses (connect slugs). The person connects each one themselves.

hosts.description: Web hosts it reads from or writes to.

runs.description: How it runs. v1 skills are instructions and text only.

license.description: An SPDX licence id, such as MIT or CC-BY-4.0.

author.description: Who the document says wrote it: a claim, never checked here.

created_at.description: When the document was written. Not hashed.

integrity.description: A sha256 over the canonical JSON: the file was not edited after it was written. Not a signature.
